observed_defect.description: The continuous service bridge was visually legible as a component, but the primary body/rail view did not explicitly show how the bridge returned to and reversibly clamped the existing rail. It could be read as a floating backing plate.
observed_defect.why_material: P02 source authority states that attachment relation must be legible before form and must not imply an unsupported independent structure.

delta: Added two explicit clamp-return loops from the service bridge toward the existing rail in the primary relation view.
Added the same clamp-return logic to the interface-stack view.
Added clamp-return markers to B on the comparison board.
Changed the main label to explicitly read two clamp returns → continuous service bridge.
